scenes.text: Think about the very last time you happily peeled and ate a fresh banana, because you probably had absolutely no idea that you were actually eating a perfect genetic clone.
Yes, literally every single Cavendish banana sold in grocery stores across the world today is genetically identical and cloned from the exact same host plant because they can no longer grow seeds.

This makes them incredibly convenient for global shipping, but it also creates a terrifying danger because one single mutated crop disease could effortlessly wipe out the entire global banana supply overnight.

This devastating agricultural disaster actually wiped out the popular, sweeter Gros Michel variety back in the nineteen-fifties, so follow for more wild facts and tell me in the comments if we can save them!
